standards.lot_coverage: Impervious cover limited to 8% (lots of 3 acres or less may reach 10,500 sq ft)

districts.name: Business Park
districts.purpose: Concentrates business and light industrial uses with supporting uses in a parklike setting.
permitted_uses: Business and light industrial uses per Table of Permissible Uses (not retrieved); manufacturing/warehousing/outdoor storage/truck terminal/data center/solar: not addressed in retrievable text
conditional_uses: Permitted-with-conditions support uses serving park employees: day care, indoor/private outdoor recreation, personal/dry cleaning/business services, shopper and specialty stores, convenience stores, carry-out and drive-through restaurants, motor vehicle fuel sales, car washes

standards.other: Support uses capped at 25% of aggregate floor area of tract (not applied in flex space); access via internal park roads; alternative design code may be approved by Planning Commission; SDAR required; Fig. VI-5 dimensions not retrieved

districts.notes: Light industrial intended; verify heavy/hazardous in Fig. IV-1.

districts.name: Aviation Business Park
districts.purpose: Commercial, employment and light industrial uses compatible with a general aviation airport.
permitted_uses: Uses per Table (not retrieved); ancillary airport equipment, facilities, utilities

standards.other: Alternative design code allowed; SDAR; Fig. VI-5

districts.name: General Industrial
districts.purpose: Industrial uses of moderate scale and intensity.
permitted_uses: Permitted uses per Table of Permissible Uses (not retrieved). Manufacturing/warehousing/outdoor storage/truck terminal/data center/solar: not addressed in retrievable text

standards.min_lot_size: May be reduced to 10,000 sq ft in subdivisions with internal circulation not accessing collector/arterial
standards.other: Fig. VI-6 (lot, yards, height) not retrieved; SDAR for commercial construction (exempt <=2,000 sf or <=25% change); buffers Art. XXIII

districts.notes: EXPRESSLY PROHIBITED in IG and IH (and similar uses): arsenals, explosives manufacture, acetylene/ammonia/fertilizer/insecticide/acid manufacture, blast furnaces, smelting, rolling mills, refining or bulk petroleum beyond tank-car lots, incinerators, landfills, rendering, tanning, ore reduction. So explosives/energetics/heavy chemical manufacturing not allowed by right; confirm with county.

districts.name: Planned Residential Development
districts.purpose: Unified residential development at Comprehensive Plan densities with flexible design and open space.
permitted_uses: Residential incl. single-family, multifamily (Fig. IV-1)

standards.other: Density per Fig. V-1; TDRs above base; buffer yards at periphery

districts.name: Planned Unit Development
districts.purpose: Recognizes the existing St. Charles PUD.
permitted_uses: Mix of residential, commercial/industrial, recreation

standards.other: Commercial/industrial 10-25% of area; at least 18% recreation/open space/community facilities

districts.notes: Only St. Charles; not available for new siting.

districts.name: Transit Oriented Development
districts.purpose: High-density transit-supportive pedestrian-friendly development near transit.
permitted_uses: Residential 20-65%, retail 10-30%, office 20-30%, institutional/civic 5-10%

standards.other: Within/near 1/4 mile of urban core; open space >=10%

districts.name: Mixed Use
districts.purpose: Master-planned mix of residential, commercial, industrial and institutional uses.
permitted_uses: Residential 20-70%, retail 10-30%, office 10-30%, civic 3-10%; light industrial may substitute for retail/office

standards.other: Open space >=20% (10% usable); intensity set at master plan approval

districts.name: Planned Employment and Industrial Park
districts.purpose: Planned light and medium industrial uses with related commercial uses.
permitted_uses: Light and medium industrial; related commercial (specifics per Fig. IV-1, not retrieved)

standards.other: FAR per Development Guidance System (Art. VIII); design code required; compatible periphery transitions

districts.notes: Most relevant planned district for industrial; heavy/energetics not addressed.

districts.name: Hughesville Village Residential Subzone
districts.purpose: Compatible infill and new low-density neighborhoods in Hughesville Village Zone.
permitted_uses: Residential subdivisions

standards.other: Lot/setbacks Fig. VI-12 (not retrieved); >=50% of open space usable

districts.notes: Sub-zone of Hughesville Village (HV); not industrial. A Hughesville Employment Subzone exists (outdoor storage/loading must be screened) but is not on the requested list.

districts.name: Town zoning (La Plata; Indian Head)
districts.purpose: Incorporated towns administer their own zoning; county Chapter 297 does not govern them.
districts.notes: Refer to each town's code. Not researched.

districts.name: Critical Area overlay (Art. IX), Highway Corridor (Art. X), Resource Protection Zone (Art. XI)
districts.purpose: Critical Area: IDZ/LDZ/RCZ zones, 100-ft Buffer landward of tidal waters/tributaries/tidal wetlands.
permitted_uses: New industrial/port facilities in Buffer only in IDZ and mapped Buffer Modification Areas; new commercial/industrial maritime facilities prohibited in RCZ Buffer; surface mining prohibited in Buffer

standards.setbacks: Buffer Modification Areas: new commercial/industrial >=50 ft from mean high water or rear yard, whichever greater; RCZ buffer >=200 ft; up to 300 ft with slopes/soils

districts.notes: No Indian Head/NSWC military overlay found in retrieved text (not confirmed absent; Art. X/XI not read).
